$ jet completions fish
[exit: 0]
--- stdout ---
# jet fish completion (generated by `jet completions fish`)
# Save to ~/.config/fish/completions/jet.fish
function __jet_no_subcommand
    set -l cmd (commandline -opc)
    set -e cmd[1]
    for w in $cmd
        switch $w
            case '-*'
            case '*'
                return 1
        end
    end
    return 0
end
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'check' -d 'look for problems, build nothing'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'build' -d 'compile to a native binary in ./build/'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'run' -d 'build, then run (or run a project)'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'test' -d 'compile and run top-level test blocks'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'new' -d 'create a new project folder'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'dev' -d 'enter the project shell (jetpack enter)'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'fmt' -d 'rewrite a file to canonical style'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'fix' -d 'apply all auto-fixable diagnostics in place'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'bind' -d 'generate a C binding cache from a header'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'lsp' -d 'language server (stdio JSON-RPC)'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'explain' -d 'print the offline essay for a diagnostic code'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'doctor' -d 'diagnose your environment (rustc, cache, PATH, FFI)'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'completions' -d 'print a shell completion script (bash|zsh|fish)'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'man' -d 'print the manual page (roff)'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'version' -d 'print the compiler version'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'help' -d 'print the help text'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'upgrade' -d 'how to download a newer release'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'add' -d 'add a dependency and fetch it'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'remove' -d 'remove a dependency'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'fetch' -d 'download and link all dependencies'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'update' -d 'refresh @latest / branch selectors'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'store' -d 'inspect the content-addressed store'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'gc' -d 'remove unreferenced store entries'
complete -c jet -n '__jet_no_subcommand' -f -a 'install' -d '(redirected) use `jet fetch` instead'
complete -c jet -l color -d 'when to colorize: auto|always|never'
complete -c jet -l json -d 'emit machine-readable JSON diagnostics'
complete -c jet -l version -d 'print the compiler version and exit'
complete -c jet -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from check' -F
complete -c jet -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from build' -F
complete -c jet -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from run' -F
complete -c jet -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from test' -F
complete -c jet -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from fmt' -F
complete -c jet -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from fix' -F
complete -c jet -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from bind' -F
